desc: Remove the current state of the machine. By default it removes only the user state if not linked to any system state.
u: zsysctl-state-remove - Remove the current state of the machine. By default it removes only the user state if not linked to any system state.
Remove the current state of the machine. By default it removes only the user state if not linked to any system state.

--dry-run[=false]
Dry run, will not remove anything
-f, --force[=false]
Force removing, even if dependencies are found
-h, --help[=false]
help for remove
-s, --system[=false]
Remove system state (system and users linked to it)
-u, --user=""
Remove the state for a given user or current user if empty
